comment: The standing comparison (docs/development/benchmarks.md). Only the frame generation kind is a KSP start of its own; the upscaler, raytracing and Ray Reconstruction (the probe's mod.<key> keys), frame generation on and off and the latency models (the proxy's live keys) are set in turn inside each start. The raytracing's rtBlas*, rtTlasFastTrace and rtMegaGeometry keys go into proxy_load: the meshes are built at the flight's start, before the first phase, so a comparison of them takes a run of its own with other values there; each start's record holds the proxy's lines of its large mesh builds (rt_builds). The radiance cache (the proxy's live rtRadianceCache) is a rendering of its own for one technique and raytracing mode, with the latency models it names; every other phase has it off. So are the opacity micromaps (the proxy's live rtOpacityMicromaps), the last rendering of the start: the first 1 makes the raytracing's pipelines with micromap support, which they keep, and the meshes' structures are rebuilt with them once their micromaps are baked, in the rendering's first seconds; every other phase has it 0. A frame generation kind may write values into the DLSS-G package's ini for its start (dlssg_ini, section by section) and name the renderings it is measured with (only): dlssg-c is the package's preset C ([DLSSG] Preset), with FSR 3 at RT Off and Full and no latency model, as a kind of dlssg for the checks; both DLSS-G starts set [Logging] FrameTiming=1, which writes the GPU time of the frame generation evaluates per frame to the dlssg-logs copied beside the raw logs. Groups: the matrix's own lists are the main group, the default run. Every entry of "groups" is the matrix with its own values over it (lists of ids or of {"extends": id, ...} for techniques, frame_generation and latency; the other keys replace, proxy_load and mod_settings merge), run by `run --group <id>`; "scenes" and "variants" multiply its starts (a variant's proxy_load goes into the proxy at load, a start of its own), and "tweaks" are renderings of their own (live proxy keys, "tweak_defaults" the values every other phase has). A frame generation kind with "steps" is measured at each multiplier (the mod's frameGenerationMultiplier through the probe's mod.<key>).
main_description: Every upscaler with raytracing off and full, every frame generation kind, every latency model, plus the radiance cache and the opacity micromaps on FSR 3 at raytracing Full. The default run.

grass.name: a field of Parallax's grass 5 km from the pad
grass.ready: Probe: grass scene, .* LANDED, .* biome Grasslands\.\r?$

groups.name: Raytracing modes
groups.description: Raytracing Off, Shadows, Light and Full for FSR 3 and DLSS (Ray Reconstruction on and off), frame generation off and FSR's.

groups.name: Frame generation steps
groups.description: DLSS-G at 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x and Dynamic with the package's MaxGeneratedFrames raised to 5, set live through the mod's frameGenerationMultiplier, for FSR 3 at raytracing Off and Full; FSR's frame generation and no frame generation as the references. The shown/rendered column is what the GPU and the driver delivered.

groups.name: DLSS-G presets
groups.description: The package's preset Auto and preset C with every upscaler at raytracing Off and Full, no latency model; FSR's frame generation and no frame generation as the references.

groups.name: Latency brake targets
groups.description: The latency brake at 4 ms (the default), 2 ms and 1 ms for FSR 3 at raytracing Off and Full, with no frame generation, FSR's and DLSS-G; no brake as the reference.

groups.name: Acceleration structure builds
groups.description: How the meshes' acceleration structures are built, one KSP start per variant (they are built at the flight's start): the start's slowest build frame and the frame rate of its first phases, FSR 3 at raytracing Full.

groups.name: Grass and terrain
groups.description: The launch pad and a field of Parallax's grass 5 km away (-redefinitionProbeGrass), FSR 3 at every raytracing mode, then at Full the radiance cache, the cut-out tests (rtCutoutTest 1 and 2, the ceiling of what the alpha tests cost) and, last, the opacity micromaps; frame generation off and FSR's.

groups.name: Atmospheres switches 1
groups.description: The settings switches of ReDefinition Atmospheres, part 1 of 3 (a start of 20 minutes at most holds about 19 renderings): one rendering for each switch (an on/off setting flipped from its default, a choice set to its first other value), FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation, the weather effects on in every phase but the one that turns them off. The settings reach the game as atmo.<key> live keys of the probe; the probe's routing of that prefix to AtmospheresSettings is not there yet. AtmospheresSwitchesTests lists the settings that have no rendering here.

tweaks.name: Cull Distant Terrain In Storms true

The settings reach the game as atmo.<key> live keys of the probe; the probe's routing of that prefix to AtmospheresSettings is not there yet. groups.name: Atmospheres switches 4
groups.description: The switches added after parts 1 to 3: the forecast map overlay and the alert screen messages (on/off flipped from their default), and the sea ice at the pad: the near-ground sheet (seaIce OrbitAndGround, the default being the orbit picture alone), the sheet switched off by the tuning key ice.groundOverlay while the setting asks for it, and the sheet's reach shortened by ice.farKm (default 80 km, here 20 km). FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation. The keys atmo.ice.groundOverlay and atmo.ice.farKm are tuning keys (ATMO_TUNING overrides, 0/1 for the flag, km for the reach), not settings of the table; the probe routes the atmo. prefix to the table where it has the key and to the tuning overrides where it has not.

tweaks.name: Ice ground overlay off by tuning

groups.name: Own clouds switches
groups.description: The on/off and choice settings of the own cloud system (ReDefinition Atmospheres, stream T, package T10), one rendering for each switch flipped from the group's base, FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation. The base of the group is the own system drawing: cloudSource Ours and ownClouds on, every other switch at its default (the default of ownClouds in the table is off until the integration package T09 accepts the system). The rows are: the switch off, a quality choice at Low, the entry refinement on, the ambient taps and the light cache on, and the reconstruction at Block (the 4 x 4 block default of cloudReconBlock) and at Low (half-size march). The numbers and the tuning keys of the system are in weather-6.

tweaks.name: Cloud Sun Colour Through Air false

groups.name: Own clouds numbers
groups.description: The number settings and the tuning keys of the own cloud system (stream T, package T10), one rendering for each value moved from the group's base, FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation. The base is the own system drawing (cloudSource Ours, ownClouds on) at the table's defaults. The keys layers.* and light.* are tuning keys (ATMO_TUNING overrides): the probe routes the atmo. prefix to the table where it has the key and to the tuning overrides where it has not. The rows: the layer cap 2, the step growth 0, one scattering octave, no powder, no moon lights, the ambient taps with the reuse 2, the shadow floor 0.5, the reconstruction block 2 and 3 in Block mode, the coverage bound off, the light stride 1, the sun march cutoff 0, the empty-space leap 4 and the entry refinement at the budget 1.

tweaks.name: Own clouds reconstructor on (4 x 4 block)
Own clouds edge step band off

groups.name: Own clouds look and far view
groups.description: The look fixes of the cloud light (T03v2) and the far view of the own clouds (T06), one rendering for each switch flipped from the group's base, FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation. The base is the own system drawing (cloudSource Ours, ownClouds on) at the table's defaults: the short 4 km sun march, the white balance on, the diffusion decay 0.02, the far view off. The rows: the 9 km sun march, the white balance off, the diffusion decay 0 (the earlier saturating glow), the far haze, the shape mean, 4 minimum samples, the march policy and the map fade on.

groups.name: Wet surfaces, droplets and lightning
groups.description: The wet overlay (T08), the window droplets (T08) and the lightning (T07), one rendering for each switch flipped from the group's base, FSR 3 at raytracing Off without frame generation, in forced rain (forceLevel 0.9, forceType Rain). The base has all three features on with every lightning part on at the table's defaults (each of the three is off in the table until the owner agrees). The rows: the wet overlay off, the droplets off, the lightning off, one stroke per second, the brightness 0.5, and each lightning part off in turn (bolts, ground light, cloud flash, thunder, the realistic thunder delay).

groups.name: Raytracing in a blizzard
groups.description: What the weather does to the rays (package C24b): FSR 3 at raytracing Full without frame generation, the weather forced to level 0.9 (a blizzard) in every phase. The plain rendering has the fog on the rays (mod.rtWeatherFog) and neither quality cost; then one rendering each without the fog, with the reach capped to three times the visibility (mod.rtWeatherReachCap), with one bounce fewer (mod.rtWeatherFewerBounces) and with both costs. The two costs are quality reductions and off by default until the owner agrees; this group measures what they save (the raytracing segment of the frame) so that the agreement can rest on numbers. The settings reach the game as mod.<key> and atmo.<key> live keys of the probe; the probe's routing of the atmo. prefix to AtmospheresSettings is not there yet.

tweaks.name: Reach cap and one bounce fewer
